hook_line: VERIZON PHONE ADDS HIT FIVE-YEAR HIGH

hook_stat.sub: Postpaid phone subscribers added in the third quarter

stats.label: Postpaid accounts added in the quarter

diaspora_bullets: Broadband added 314,000 connections in the quarter
news_summary: Verizon beat third-quarter earnings estimates as it added 406,000 postpaid phone subscribers, its strongest third quarter in five years, and raised its full-year outlook for the third consecutive quarter.
payoff: Verizon raised its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.04 to $5.06.
